description: Get the current exchange rate for an asset in a fiat currency (rate = fiat units per 1 whole asset unit, with source provenance). Assets: Btc, Usdc, Usdt, Eurc. 165 ISO-4217 fiat currencies are supported.

fiatCurrency.description: Fiat currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, SEK
